The Fallen Star · 1

One twilight morning, a letter floated down to the Cova door. It was written in the secret Starcora code. “Oh bolts!” said Oro. “Whatever does it say?”

The Secret Letter

Crack the secret code

Tap the letter to open it.

Tap to open!

The secret key

STAR!

“A fallen star, somewhere in the Moonmist!” said Sola. “Let’s find it.”

The Fallen Star · 2

The trio set off into the Moonmist. The path grew darker and darker, until they could hardly see their feet. “Stay close,” said Sola.

Light the Way

Find the lanterns

Tap Sola’s sun badge to make her glow.

The path shines!

One, two, three, four, five! The lantern-blooms glowed, and the whole path shone bright. “This way!” said Sola.

The Fallen Star · 3

A giant bud blocked the trail, shut tight. Oro pushed. Sola pulled. It would not budge. “Oh, look,” said Rose softly. “Why don’t we just ask it to open?”

The Sleepy Bud

Wake the bud

Put your finger on Rose’s flower. Trace the swirl all the way to the middle.

Oh, look!

The bud stretched, and yawned, and opened wide. “Thank you,” whispered Rose. The path was clear!

The Fallen Star · 4

“I can see something shining up ahead! It looks like a…” Oro stopped. Not one bolt moved. “Oh Oroooo!” giggled Rose. “He needs winding up!”

Oh Bolts!

Wind up Oro

Put your finger on the key and turn it round and round. Three big turns!

…STAR!

“…STAR!” finished Oro, just as if nothing had happened. Rose and Sola laughed. “Come on, let’s go and see!”

The Fallen Star · 5

There it was! The fallen star, caught high in a Spiral Tree, far too high to reach. Oro tapped his moon badge. “Leave it to me!”

Stuck Up High

Bring the star down

Help Oro pull the star down. Drag it through the vines into the basket!

Got it!

Oro’s moon badge glowed silver, and down floated the star, through the vines and safe into the basket. “Got it!” said Oro.

The Fallen Star · 6

Back at the Cova door, Rose hugged the star tight. “We did it!” cheered Oro. Then they carried it inside, to keep it safe in the Cova Chest.

Safe in the Chest

Keep the star safe

Drag the star into the Cova Chest.

The lid closed with a soft click, and the Saturn carving glowed. “Now we have our star,” said Sola.

Suddenly, something zoomed across the sky, and landed in the Moonmist with a great big CRASH!

Find out what crashed in the next book!

The End
